586
588inline uint8 GetLightingChannelMaskForStruct(FLightingChannels Value)
589{
590 // Note: this is packed into 3 bits of a stencil channel
591 return (uint8)((Value.bChannel0 ? 1 : 0) | (Value.bChannel1 << 1) | (Value.bChannel2 << 2));
592}
593
595inline uint8 GetDefaultLightingChannelMask()
596{
597 return 1;
598}
599
601inline int32 GetFirstLightingChannelFromMask(uint8 Mask)
602{
603 return Mask ? FPlatformMath::CountTrailingZeros(Mask) : -1;
604}

730static_assert(MSM_NUM <= 16, "Do not exceed 16 shading models without expanding FMaterialShadingModelField to support uint32 instead of uint16!");
731
733USTRUCT()
734struct FMaterialShadingModelField
735{
736 GENERATED_USTRUCT_BODY()
737
738public:
739 FMaterialShadingModelField() {}
740 FMaterialShadingModelField(EMaterialShadingModel InShadingModel) { AddShadingModel(InShadingModel); }
741
742 void AddShadingModel(EMaterialShadingModel InShadingModel) { check(InShadingModel < MSM_NUM); ShadingModelField |= (1 << (uint16)InShadingModel); }
743 void RemoveShadingModel(EMaterialShadingModel InShadingModel) { ShadingModelField &= ~(1 << (uint16)InShadingModel); }
744 void ClearShadingModels() { ShadingModelField = 0; }
745
746 // Check if any of the given shading models are present
747 bool HasAnyShadingModel(const TArray<EMaterialShadingModel>& InShadingModels) const
748 {
749 for (EMaterialShadingModel ShadingModel : InShadingModels)
750 {
751 if (HasShadingModel(ShadingModel))
752 {
753 return true;
754 }
755 }
756 return false;
757 }
758
759 bool HasShadingModel(EMaterialShadingModel InShadingModel) const { return (ShadingModelField & (1 << (uint16)InShadingModel)) != 0; }
760 bool HasOnlyShadingModel(EMaterialShadingModel InShadingModel) const { return ShadingModelField == (1 << (uint16)InShadingModel); }
761 bool IsUnlit() const { return HasShadingModel(MSM_Unlit); }
762 bool IsLit() const { return !IsUnlit(); }
763 bool IsValid() const { return (ShadingModelField > 0) && (ShadingModelField < (1 << MSM_NUM)); }
764 uint16 GetShadingModelField() const { return ShadingModelField; }
765 void SetShadingModelField(uint16 InShadingModelField) { ShadingModelField = InShadingModelField; }
766 int32 CountShadingModels() const { return FMath::CountBits(ShadingModelField); }
767 EMaterialShadingModel GetFirstShadingModel() const { check(IsValid()); return (EMaterialShadingModel)FMath::CountTrailingZeros(ShadingModelField); }
768
769 bool operator==(const FMaterialShadingModelField& Other) const { return ShadingModelField == Other.GetShadingModelField(); }
770 bool operator!=(const FMaterialShadingModelField& Other) const { return ShadingModelField != Other.GetShadingModelField(); }
771
772private:
773 UPROPERTY()
774 uint16 ShadingModelField = 0;
775};

839// This used to track cyclic graph which we do not support. We only support acyclic graph and a depth of 128 is already too high for a realistic use case.
840#define SUBSTRATE_TREE_MAX_DEPTH 48
841
843struct FSubstrateMaterialInfo
844{
845public:
846 FSubstrateMaterialInfo(bool bGatherGuids = false) { bGatherMaterialExpressionGuids = bGatherGuids; }
847 FSubstrateMaterialInfo(ESubstrateShadingModel InShadingModel) { AddShadingModel(InShadingModel); }
848
849 // Shading model
850 void AddShadingModel(ESubstrateShadingModel InShadingModel) { check(InShadingModel < SSM_NUM); ShadingModelField |= (1u << (uint32)InShadingModel); }
851 void SetSingleShadingModel(ESubstrateShadingModel InShadingModel) { check(InShadingModel < SSM_NUM); ShadingModelField = (1u << (uint32)InShadingModel); }
852 bool HasShadingModel(ESubstrateShadingModel InShadingModel) const { return (ShadingModelField & (1u << (uint32)InShadingModel)) != 0; }
853 bool HasOnlyShadingModel(ESubstrateShadingModel InShadingModel) const { return ShadingModelField == (1u << (uint32)InShadingModel); }
854 uint32 GetShadingModelField() const { return ShadingModelField; }
855 int32 CountShadingModels() const { return FMath::CountBits(ShadingModelField); }
856
857 // Subsurface profiles
858 void AddSubsurfaceProfile(USubsurfaceProfile* InProfile) { if (InProfile) SubsurfaceProfiles.Add(InProfile); }
859 int32 CountSubsurfaceProfiles() const { return SubsurfaceProfiles.Num(); }
860 USubsurfaceProfile* GetSubsurfaceProfile(int32 Index) const { return SubsurfaceProfiles.IsValidIndex(Index) ? SubsurfaceProfiles[Index] : nullptr; }
861
862 // Specular profiles
863 void AddSpecularProfile(USpecularProfile* InProfile) { if (InProfile) SpecularProfiles.Add(InProfile); }
864 int32 CountSpecularProfiles() const { return SpecularProfiles.Num(); }
865 USpecularProfile* GetSpecularProfile(int32 Index) const { return SpecularProfiles.IsValidIndex(Index) ? SpecularProfiles[Index] : nullptr; }
866
867 // Toon profiles
868 void AddToonProfile(UToonProfile* InProfile) { if (InProfile) ToonProfiles.Add(InProfile); }
869 int32 CountToonProfiles() const { return ToonProfiles.Num(); }
870 UToonProfile* GetToonProfile(int32 Index) const { return ToonProfiles.IsValidIndex(Index) ? ToonProfiles[Index] : nullptr; }
871
872 // Shading model from expression
873 void SetShadingModelFromExpression(bool bIn) { bHasShadingModelFromExpression = bIn ? 1u : 0u; }
874 bool HasShadingModelFromExpression() const { return bHasShadingModelFromExpression > 0u; }
875
876 // Substrate material expression GUIDs
877 void AddGuid(const FGuid& In) { if (bGatherMaterialExpressionGuids) { MaterialExpressionGuids.Add(In); } }
878 const TArray<FGuid>& GetGuids() const { return MaterialExpressionGuids; }
879
880 uint64 GetPropertyConnected() const { return ConnectedPropertyMask; }
881 void AddPropertyConnected(uint64 In) { ConnectedPropertyMask |= (1ull << In); }
882 bool HasPropertyConnected(uint64 In) const { return !!(ConnectedPropertyMask & (1ull << In)); }
883 static bool HasPropertyConnected(uint64 InConnectedPropertyMask, uint64 In) { return !!(InConnectedPropertyMask & (1ull << In)); }
884
885 bool IsValid() const { return (ShadingModelField > 0) && (ShadingModelField < (1 << SSM_NUM)); }
886
887 bool operator==(const FSubstrateMaterialInfo& Other) const { return ShadingModelField == Other.GetShadingModelField(); }
888 bool operator!=(const FSubstrateMaterialInfo& Other) const { return ShadingModelField != Other.GetShadingModelField(); }
889
890#if WITH_EDITOR
891 // Returns true if everything went fine (not out of Substrate tree stack)
892 bool PushSubstrateTreeStack()
893 {
894 bOutOfStackDepthWhenParsing = bOutOfStackDepthWhenParsing || (++ParsingStackDepth > SUBSTRATE_TREE_MAX_DEPTH);
895 return !bOutOfStackDepthWhenParsing;
896 }
897 void PopSubstrateTreeStack()
898 {
899 ParsingStackDepth--;
900 check(ParsingStackDepth >= 0);
901 }
902 bool GetSubstrateTreeOutOfStackDepthOccurred()
903 {
904 return bOutOfStackDepthWhenParsing;
905 }
906#endif
907
908private:
909 uint32 ShadingModelField = 0;
910
911 /* Indicates if the shading model is constant or data-driven from the shader graph */
912 uint8 bHasShadingModelFromExpression = 0;
913
914 /* Indicates which (legacy) inputs are connected */
915 uint64 ConnectedPropertyMask = 0;
916

1867inline ECollisionEnabled::Type CollisionEnabledIntersection(ECollisionEnabled::Type CollisionEnabledA, ECollisionEnabled::Type CollisionEnabledB)
1868{
1869 // Combine collision two enabled data.
1870 //
1871 // The intersection follows the following rules:
1872 //
1873 // * For the result to have Query, both data must have Query
1874 // * For the result to have Probe, either data must have Probe
1875 // * For the result to have Physics, both data must have Physics and the result must not have Probe
1876 //
1877 // This way if an object is query-only, for example, but one of its shapes is query-and-physics,
1878 // the object's settings win and the shape ends up being query-only. And if the object is marked
1879 // as physics, but the child is marked as probe (or vice versa), use probe.
1880 //
1881 // The following matrix represents the intersection relationship.
1882 // NOTE: The order of types must match the order declared in ECollisionEnabled!
1883 using namespace ECollisionEnabled;
1884 static constexpr ECollisionEnabled::Type IntersectionMatrix[5][5] = {
1885 /* | QueryOnly PhysicsOnly QueryAndPhysics ProbeOnly QueryAndProbe */
1886 /*-----------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
1887 /* QueryOnly | */ { QueryOnly, NoCollision, QueryOnly, NoCollision, QueryOnly },
1888 /* PhysicsOnly | */ { NoCollision, PhysicsOnly, PhysicsOnly, ProbeOnly, ProbeOnly },
1889 /* QueryAndPhysics | */ { QueryOnly, PhysicsOnly, QueryAndPhysics, ProbeOnly, QueryAndProbe },
1890 /* ProbeOnly | */ { NoCollision, ProbeOnly, ProbeOnly, ProbeOnly, ProbeOnly },
1891 /* QueryAndProbe | */ { QueryOnly, ProbeOnly, QueryAndProbe, ProbeOnly, QueryAndProbe }
1892 };
1893
1894 // Subtract 1 because the first index is NoCollision.
1895 // If both indices indicate _some_ collision setting (ie, greater than -1),
1896 // lookup their intersection setting in the matrix.
1897 const int32 IndexA = (int32)CollisionEnabledA - 1;
1898 const int32 IndexB = (int32)CollisionEnabledB - 1;
1899 if (IndexA >= 0 && IndexB >= 0)
1900 {
1901 return IntersectionMatrix[IndexA][IndexB];
1902 }
1903
1904 // Either of the two settings were set to NoCollision which trumps all
1905 return ECollisionEnabled::NoCollision;
1906}
1907
1909inline ECollisionEnabled::Type CollisionEnabledFromFlags(const bool bQuery, const bool bPhysics, const bool bProbe)
1910{
1911 // Convert to ints for bit manipulation
1912 const int32 QueryBit = static_cast<uint32>(bQuery);
1913 const int32 PhysicsBit = static_cast<uint32>(bPhysics);
1914 const int32 ProbeBit = static_cast<uint32>(bProbe);
1915
1916 // NOTE:
1917 // We use &~ between physics and probe because we cannot have a case with
1918 // both enabled, and in every case probe "beats" physics. See the collision
1919 // type rules outlined in the comments in CollisionEnabledIntersection.
1920 //
1921 // index type bits: probe/physics/query
1922 // ----------------------------------------------------
1923 // 0 NoCollision 000
1924 // 1 QueryOnly 001
1925 // 2 PhysicsOnly 010
1926 // 3 QueryAndPhysics 011
1927 // 4 ProbeOnly 100 (& 110)
1928 // 5 QueryAndProbe 101 (& 111)
1929 return static_cast<ECollisionEnabled::Type>(
1930 (QueryBit << 0) |
1931 (PhysicsBit & (~ProbeBit)) << 1 |
1932 (ProbeBit << 2));
1933}
1934
1936inline void CollisionEnabledToFlags(const ECollisionEnabled::Type CollisionEnabled, bool& bQuery, bool& bPhysics, bool& bProbe)
1937{
1938 const int32 Bits = static_cast<int32>(CollisionEnabled);
1939 bQuery = ((Bits & 0x1) != 0);
1940 bPhysics = ((Bits & 0x2) != 0);
1941 bProbe = ((Bits & 0x4) != 0);
1942}

2189struct FRotationConversionCache
2190{
2191 FRotationConversionCache()
2192 {
2193 }
2194
2196 inline FQuat RotatorToQuat(const FRotator& InRotator) const
2197 {
2198 FPayload& Payload = GetOrCreatePayload();
2199 if (LIKELY(Payload.CachedRotator != InRotator))
2200 {
2201 Payload.CachedRotator = InRotator.GetNormalized();
2202 Payload.CachedQuat = Payload.CachedRotator.Quaternion();
2203 }
2204 return Payload.CachedQuat;
2205 }
2206
2208 inline FQuat RotatorToQuat_ReadOnly(const FRotator& InRotator) const
2209 {
2210 if (LIKELY(PayloadPtr.IsValid()))
2211 {
2212 FPayload& Payload = *PayloadPtr;
2213 if (LIKELY(Payload.CachedRotator == InRotator))
2214 {
2215 return Payload.CachedQuat;
2216 }
2217 }
2218 return InRotator.Quaternion();
2219 }
2220
2222 inline FRotator QuatToRotator(const FQuat& InQuat) const
2223 {
2224 FPayload& Payload = GetOrCreatePayload();
2225 if (LIKELY(Payload.CachedQuat != InQuat))
2226 {
2227 Payload.CachedQuat = InQuat.GetNormalized();
2228 Payload.CachedRotator = Payload.CachedQuat.Rotator();
2229 }
2230 return Payload.CachedRotator;
2231 }
2232
2234 inline FRotator QuatToRotator_ReadOnly(const FQuat& InQuat) const
2235 {
2236 if (LIKELY(PayloadPtr.IsValid()))
2237 {
2238 FPayload& Payload = *PayloadPtr;
2239 if (LIKELY(Payload.CachedQuat == InQuat))
2240 {
2241 return Payload.CachedRotator;
2242 }
2243 }
2244 return InQuat.GetNormalized().Rotator();
2245 }
2246
2248 inline FRotator NormalizedQuatToRotator(const FQuat& InNormalizedQuat) const
2249 {
2250 FPayload& Payload = GetOrCreatePayload();
2251 if (LIKELY(Payload.CachedQuat != InNormalizedQuat))
2252 {
2253 Payload.CachedQuat = InNormalizedQuat;
2254 Payload.CachedRotator = InNormalizedQuat.Rotator();
2255 }
2256 return Payload.CachedRotator;
2257 }
2258
2260 inline FRotator NormalizedQuatToRotator_ReadOnly(const FQuat& InNormalizedQuat) const
2261 {
2262 if (LIKELY(PayloadPtr.IsValid()))
2263 {
2264 FPayload& Payload = *PayloadPtr;
2265 if (LIKELY(Payload.CachedQuat == InNormalizedQuat))
2266 {
2267 return Payload.CachedRotator;
2268 }
2269 }
2270 return InNormalizedQuat.Rotator();
2271 }
2272
2274 inline FQuat GetCachedQuat() const
2275 {
2276 if (UNLIKELY(!PayloadPtr.IsValid()))
2277 {
2278 return FQuat::Identity;
2279 }
2280 return PayloadPtr->CachedQuat;
2281 }
2282
2284 inline FRotator GetCachedRotator() const
2285 {
2286 if (UNLIKELY(!PayloadPtr.IsValid()))
2287 {
2288 return FRotator::ZeroRotator;
2289 }
2290 return PayloadPtr->CachedRotator;
2291 }
2292
2293 FRotationConversionCache& operator=(const FRotationConversionCache& Other)
2294 {
2295 if (LIKELY(PayloadPtr.IsValid() || Other.PayloadPtr.IsValid()))
2296 {
2297 FPayload& Payload = GetOrCreatePayload();
2298 Payload.CachedQuat = Other.GetCachedQuat();
2299 Payload.CachedRotator = Other.GetCachedRotator();
2300 }
2301 return *this;
2302 }
2303
2304private:
2305
2306 struct FPayload
2307 {

2468 (fabsf(A.EmissiveLightFalloffExponent - B.EmissiveLightFalloffExponent) > UE_SMALL_NUMBER) ||
2469 (fabsf(A.EmissiveLightExplicitInfluenceRadius - B.EmissiveLightExplicitInfluenceRadius) > UE_SMALL_NUMBER) ||
2470 (fabsf(A.EmissiveBoost - B.EmissiveBoost) > UE_SMALL_NUMBER) ||
2471 (fabsf(A.DiffuseBoost - B.DiffuseBoost) > UE_SMALL_NUMBER) ||
2472 (fabsf(A.FullyOccludedSamplesFraction - B.FullyOccludedSamplesFraction) > UE_SMALL_NUMBER))
2473 {

2475 }

3723USTRUCT(BlueprintType)
3724struct FWalkableSlopeOverride
3725{
3726 GENERATED_BODY()
3727
3728
3732 UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category=WalkableSlopeOverride)
3733 TEnumAsByte<EWalkableSlopeBehavior> WalkableSlopeBehavior;
3734
3739 UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category=WalkableSlopeOverride, meta=(ClampMin="0", ClampMax="90", UIMin="0", UIMax="90"))
3740 float WalkableSlopeAngle;
3741
3742private:
3743
3744 // Cached angle for which we computed a cosine.
3745 mutable float CachedSlopeAngle;
3746 // Cached cosine of angle.
3747 mutable float CachedSlopeCos;
3748
3749public:
3750
3751 FWalkableSlopeOverride()
3752 : WalkableSlopeBehavior(WalkableSlope_Default)
3753 , WalkableSlopeAngle(0.f)
3754 , CachedSlopeAngle(0.f)
3755 , CachedSlopeCos(1.f)
3756 { }
3757
3758 FWalkableSlopeOverride(EWalkableSlopeBehavior NewSlopeBehavior, float NewSlopeAngle)
3759 : WalkableSlopeBehavior(NewSlopeBehavior)
3760 , WalkableSlopeAngle(NewSlopeAngle)
3761 , CachedSlopeAngle(0.f)
3762 , CachedSlopeCos(1.f)
3763 {
3764 }
3765
3767 inline EWalkableSlopeBehavior GetWalkableSlopeBehavior() const
3768 {
3769 return WalkableSlopeBehavior;
3770 }
3771
3773 inline float GetWalkableSlopeAngle() const
3774 {
3775 return WalkableSlopeAngle;
3776 }
3777
3779 inline void SetWalkableSlopeBehavior(EWalkableSlopeBehavior NewSlopeBehavior)
3780 {
3781 WalkableSlopeBehavior = NewSlopeBehavior;
3782 }
3783
3785 inline void SetWalkableSlopeAngle(float NewSlopeAngle)
3786 {
3787 WalkableSlopeAngle = FMath::Clamp(NewSlopeAngle, 0.f, 90.f);
3788 }
3789
3791 float ModifyWalkableFloorZ(float InWalkableFloorZ) const
3792 {
3793 switch(WalkableSlopeBehavior)
3794 {
3795 case WalkableSlope_Default:
3796 {
3797 return InWalkableFloorZ;
3798 }
3799
3800 case WalkableSlope_Increase:
3801 {
3802 CheckCachedData();
3803 return FMath::Min(InWalkableFloorZ, CachedSlopeCos);
3804 }
3805
3806 case WalkableSlope_Decrease:
3807 {
3808 CheckCachedData();
3809 return FMath::Max(InWalkableFloorZ, CachedSlopeCos);
3810 }
3811
3812 case WalkableSlope_Unwalkable:
3813 {
3814 // Z component of a normal will always be less than this, so this will be unwalkable.
3815 return 2.0f;
3816 }
3817
3818 case WalkableSlope_Max:
3819 default:
3820 {
3821 return InWalkableFloorZ;
3822 }
3823 }
3824 }
3825
3826private:
3827
3828 void CheckCachedData() const
3829 {
3830 if (CachedSlopeAngle != WalkableSlopeAngle)
3831 {
3832 const float AngleRads = FMath::DegreesToRadians(WalkableSlopeAngle);
3833 CachedSlopeCos = FMath::Clamp(FMath::Cos(AngleRads), 0.f, 1.f);
3834 CachedSlopeAngle = WalkableSlopeAngle;
3835 }
3836 }
3837};

4169USTRUCT(BlueprintType)
4170struct FDebugFloatHistory
4171{
4172 GENERATED_BODY()
4173
4174private:
4176 UPROPERTY(Transient)
4177 TArray<float> Samples;
4178
4179public:
4181 UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category="DebugFloatHistory")
4182 int32 MaxSamples;
4183
4185 UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "DebugFloatHistory")
4186 float MinValue;
4187
4189 UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "DebugFloatHistory")
4190 float MaxValue;
4191
4193 UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "DebugFloatHistory")
4194 bool bAutoAdjustMinMax;
4195
4196 FDebugFloatHistory()
4197 : MaxSamples(100)
4198 , MinValue(0.f)
4199 , MaxValue(0.f)
4200 , bAutoAdjustMinMax(true)
4201 { }
4202
4203 FDebugFloatHistory(int32 const & InMaxSamples, float const & InMinValue, float const & InMaxValue, bool const & InbAutoAdjustMinMax)
4204 : MaxSamples(InMaxSamples)
4205 , MinValue(InMinValue)
4206 , MaxValue(InMaxValue)
4207 , bAutoAdjustMinMax(InbAutoAdjustMinMax)
4208 { }
4209
4217 void AddSample(float const & FloatValue)
4218 {
4219 if (bAutoAdjustMinMax)
4220 {
4221 // Adjust bounds and record value.
4222 MinValue = FMath::Min(MinValue, FloatValue);
4223 MaxValue = FMath::Max(MaxValue, FloatValue);
4224 Samples.Insert(FloatValue, 0);
4225 }
4226 else
4227 {
4228 // Record clamped value.
4229 Samples.Insert(FMath::Clamp(FloatValue, MinValue, MaxValue), 0);
4230 }
4231
4232 // Do not exceed MaxSamples recorded.
4233 if( Samples.Num() > MaxSamples )
4234 {
4235 Samples.RemoveAt(MaxSamples, Samples.Num() - MaxSamples);
4236 }
4237 }
4238
4240 float GetMinMaxRange() const
4241 {
4242 return (MaxValue - MinValue);
4243 }
4244
4246 float GetMinValue() const
4247 {
4248 return MinValue;
4249 }
4250
4252 float GetMaxValue() const
4253 {
4254 return MaxValue;
4255 }
4256
4258 int GetNumSamples() const
4259 {
4260 return Samples.Num();
4261 }
4262
4264 TArray<float> const & GetSamples() const
4265 {
4266 return Samples;
4267 }
4268};

4272struct FDepthFieldGlowInfo
4273{
4274 GENERATED_BODY()
4275
4276
4277 UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category="Glow")
4278 uint32 bEnableGlow:1;
4279
4281 UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category="Glow")
4282 FLinearColor GlowColor;
4283
4288 UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category="Glow")
4289 FVector2D GlowOuterRadius;
4290
4295 UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category="Glow")
4296 FVector2D GlowInnerRadius;
4297
4298
4299 FDepthFieldGlowInfo()
4300 : bEnableGlow(false)
4301 , GlowColor(ForceInit)
4302 , GlowOuterRadius(ForceInit)
4303 , GlowInnerRadius(ForceInit)
4304 { }
4305
4306 bool operator==(const FDepthFieldGlowInfo& Other) const
4307 {
4308 if (Other.bEnableGlow != bEnableGlow)
4309 {
4310 return false;
4311 }
4312 else if (!bEnableGlow)
4313 {
4314 // if the glow is disabled on both, the other values don't matter
4315 return true;
4316 }
4317 else
4318 {
4319 return (Other.GlowColor == GlowColor && Other.GlowOuterRadius == GlowOuterRadius && Other.GlowInnerRadius == GlowInnerRadius);
4320 }
4321 }
4322
4323 bool operator!=(const FDepthFieldGlowInfo& Other) const
4324 {
4325 return !(*this == Other);
4326 }
4327};
